analysis.scope: Same compiled Java/native controller; fresh labelled synthetic worlds. Four task pairs with alternating mode order, not randomized or enough for population confidence. Reference still uses one canonical pass per read (prior090 used two), so this isolates digest reuse against an already simplified full-check baseline. Existing independent arithmetic is not a second physics solver. No calibration or LLM training performed.

finding: Digest reuse reduced canonical verification passes by 94.2% and took 40.07 s less across the eight task calls (four paired comparisons). All nine new native goals completed and verified. Every original outcome check remains active.
testSummary: 268 Java cases passed across 35 classes; 1 host-dependent case skipped; 135 desktop checks passed. A separate Windows directory-junction refusal probe passed. Nine fresh native goals and eight full post-task audits were independently inspected.
